title: Fixed Open Platen and Coaxial Hopper Barrel Machine
description: One wholly newly authored complete injection-moulding-machine-style static exterior. One long grounded machine base carries a left clamp-tail plate, four full longitudinal rods, a fixed end platen and a complete intermediate platen with four genuinely open rod windows and its own whole base shoe. Two complete blank tooling-style blocks face one another across a real open central interval, one with a true blind recess and the other with an integral short raised face. A complete rear cylinder/rod exterior belongs to this left station. To its right, one coaxial stepped barrel exterior rests on two full pedestals, enters a separate rear drive-case exterior and supports a genuinely empty open thick hopper/neck. A whole outboard support and blank control-panel exterior complete the single machine. This is not the old plate-filter press with fewer plates: there is no hanging plate bank, two lateral supporting rails, under-collector or bored filter inlet; the corner-rod clamping station and rear barrel/feed/drive station are new overall organisation. It is not a log-splitter beam with a new wedge, and no old mesh is imported or extracted. One prop zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontally centred envelope with four true foot soles. Empty fixed art exterior only. No polymer, screw internals, heating, nozzle passage, pressure, injection, matched mold, clamping force, movement, electrical function, manufacturing process, load, protection or safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made or verified.
